tested_features.POST_/api/chat_empty_message: PASS — backend returns 200 (LLM handles empty gracefully, no crash)
tested_features.POST_/api/chat_persists_mongo: PASS — /chat/sessions reflects new session with count >= 2 after a single /chat call (i.e. user + assistant docs inserted)
tested_features.GET_/api/chat/sessions_schema: PASS — returns list of {session_id, last_message, last_at, count}; no _id leak
tested_features.frontend_freetext_modal_rasa_hits_LLM: PASS — POST /api/chat fired; bot reply mentions Modal Rasa / kepercayaan / emosional
tested_features.frontend_quickreply_Lihat_Harga_no_LLM: PASS — zero /api/chat calls; pricing list (Rp 55.000) renders immediately
tested_features.frontend_freetext_'jelaskan_bab_7'_hits_: PASS — POST /api/chat fired (intent 'tentang' not in FAST_INTENTS)
tested_features.frontend_session_id_persisted_localStora: PASS — gk_chat_session_id present after first LLM reply
tested_features.backend_regression_leads_cta_stats: PASS — all 9 prior pytest cases still green
tested_features.EMERGENT_LLM_KEY_from_env: PASS — server.py reads os.environ.get('EMERGENT_LLM_KEY'); .env contains the key, no hardcode in source

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/chat: empty message currently passes through to the LLM (returns 200 with a polite reply). Acceptable per spec ('4xx or 200 both ok'), but a server-side guard (e.g. 400 if len(message.strip())==0) would save an LLM call and cost.

server.py /api/chat: history is appended into the system_message rather than passed as proper assistant/user turns to LlmChat. Works but means 'usage' tokens are billed as system prompt every turn; consider sending history as actual UserMessage/AssistantMessage objects if emergentintegrations supports it.

server.py /api/chat: error path raises HTTPException(502) on any LLM failure — good; but the upstream error string is truncated to 200 chars only in detail. Consider logging full stacktrace (already done via logger.exception).
server.py /api/chat/sessions: pipeline groups by session_id and returns last text — fine. Consider adding a 'first_at' or filtering empty sessions for admin UI.
AIChatWidget.jsx callLlm: sends entire chat history each call (last 8 truncated server-side). After many turns this grows; client-side could also cap to last 8 to reduce payload.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth on this app.
seed_data_creation: Test chat sessions are inserted into db.chat_messages during tests; prefixed test message contains 'TEST_persist_' so they can be filtered if cleanup is desired. Not auto-cleaned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses emergentintegrations LlmChat with anthropic claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929. LLM latency typically 3-8s — set timeout >= 30s for any chat test. Frontend FAST_INTENTS set: {bab1, harga, wa, select-free, select-perbab, select-full, pay-transfer, pay-qris} → these never call /api/chat. All other intents (tentang, rekomendasi, fallback, etc.) go to LLM. session_id stored in localStorage key 'gk_chat_session_id'. /api/chat/sessions endpoint is currently public (no auth gate) — may need protection if used in production admin.
